title: Concept: Sensitive value in log call (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, puts "password=#{p}" places a credential-named value on a log line. Log pipelines retain data for months and expose it to support tooling, so logged secrets effectively become shared. The remedy is logging presence flags or redacted markers.
applicability: ruby codebases emitting logs; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential disclosure to log readers and retention stores; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when logs ship to third parties.
